sentences.en: I call the living, I mourn the dead, I repel lightning.
sentences.zh: 我呼唤生者，为死者哀悼，驱退雷电。

sentences.en: Scientists have created a forcefield that only repels spitballs.
sentences.zh: 科学家们创造了一种力场，专门用来抵御飞镖（这里指‘ Spitballs’是儿童用的纸团，通常用来投掷，故译为飞镖）。

sentences.en: Giraffes have pretty strong body odor that repels mosquitos.
sentences.zh: 长颈鹿身上有一种很强烈的体味，能驱赶蚊子。
